name: Dracula
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: Dracula was written by Bram Stoker, first published in 1897.
Told through letters and diary entries, Jonathan Harker's visit to Transylvania unleashes the vampire Count Dracula on Victorian London -- the novel that defined the modern vampire myth.
Discussion prompt: Fear of the Foreign is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
